sanskrit_verse:
पुरुषोऽनृतवादी च पिशुनः परुषस्तथा ।
अनिबद्धप्रलापी च मृगपक्षिषु जायते ॥
transliteration: puruṣo 'nṛtavādī ca piśunaḥ paruṣas tathā / anibaddhapralāpī ca mṛgapakṣiṣu jāyate //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who speaks falsely, slanders others, uses harsh speech, and engages in aimless chatter—such a person takes birth among animals and birds.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: Speech originates from consciousness; misuse distorts existential alignment.
Causation: Disharmonic use of speech generates karmic momentum leading to non-human rebirth.
Capacity-based responsibility: The ability to speak truthfully implies the duty to do so.
Restoration logic: Rebirth reflects the necessity to purify distorted capacities through experiential learning.
Consciousness alignment: Misuse of speech misaligns individual consciousness with universal dharma.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent uses false speech THEN initiate consciousness-realignment protocol.
IF agent engages in slander THEN assign completion process for integrity restoration.
IF agent employs harsh language THEN trigger empathy calibration sequence.
IF agent indulges in meaningless talk THEN enforce focus and purpose reconstruction.
IF agent's speech causes dissonance THEN activate karmic resonance correction mechanism.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes that misuse of speech—including perjury, defamation, or inflammatory rhetoric—is a violation of ontological dharma. Responsibility is determined by capacity to discern truthful communication. Restoration occurs through experiential recalibration rather than punitive sentencing.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that causal distortion in speech leads to distorted embodiment. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows sequential degradation of communicative purity culminating in lower births. Proportional responsibility lies in restoring clarity of expression. Non-punitive reality rule confirms suffering arises not as judgment but as natural consequence for realignment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Truth Resonance Training to restore authentic expression.
Assign Slander Accountability Process to rebuild relational integrity.
Implement Harsh Speech Rehabilitation to cultivate compassionate dialogue.
Enforce Discourse Discipline Protocol to eliminate mental and verbal clutter.
Activate Karmic Echo Correction to dissolve residual distortions from past misuses.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law restores cosmic balance through consciousness purification, upholds the supremacy of truthful speech, and affirms reality as non-punitive, governed solely by the principle of alignment.
